title: The shortest descent
prompt:
Travel from S to T in exactly 1099511627783 directed edge traversals. Vertices and edges may be revisited.
    Find the minimum total cost and count distinct minimum-cost edge sequences, modulo 1000000007.
    Negative cycles are allowed: the exact traversal count makes the question finite.
    Submit cost:count, ordinary signed decimal cost and unsigned modular count, with no spaces.
    A trillion steps can be folded by squaring. Equal minima add their witnesses; consecutive journeys multiply them.
